resources.string: Showing subtitles over the TV\'s HDMI picture
Nino subtitles stopped. Open Nino again to turn them back on.
Overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
No picture inside Nino. Switching to overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
Switch the TV to the PS5\'s input (HDMI %1$d) with the remote. Subtitles will appear on top.
Overlay mode needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.
The PS5 picture is not coming through inside Nino. On some TVs it stays black here; overlay mode fixes this, but it needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.

The PS5 picture is not coming through inside Nino. On some TVs it stays black here. Overlay mode fixes this, but it is only in the TV app that Nino on your computer installs: uninstall this copy, turn on USB debugging on the TV and start the translation on your computer.

Nino on your computer grants it when it installs the TV app: start the translation there with USB debugging on. Or on the TV open Settings › Apps › Special app access › Display over other apps and turn on Nino.
Nino is on. Subtitles will appear over the PS5 picture; start translating from Nino on your computer or phone.
Press the input button again to choose the PS5\'s input.
